title: Modal
description: An accessible modal dialog with focus trapping, scroll locking, animations, nesting support, and compound sub-components.

onOpenChange.description: (open: boolean) => void - Callback when the modal's open state changes.

defaultOpen.description: Whether the modal is initially open (uncontrolled).

children.description: React.ReactNode - Modal body content. Use ModalHeader, ModalBody, ModalFooter for structure.

title.description: React.ReactNode - Title rendered in the modal header.

description.description: React.ReactNode - Description rendered below the title in the header.

icon.description: React.ReactNode - Icon rendered in the modal header.

showIcon.description: Whether to display the icon in the header.

showCloseButton.description: Whether to display the close button.

showHeader.description: Whether to render the built-in header section.

showOverlay.description: Whether to render the backdrop overlay.

preventOutsideClick.description: Prevents closing when clicking outside the modal content.

closeOnEscape.description: Enables closing via the Escape key.

lockScroll.description: Locks body scroll when the modal is open.

trapFocus.description: Traps keyboard focus within the modal.

restoreFocus.description: Restores focus to the previously focused element on close.

initialFocus.description: RefObject<HTMLElement | null> - Element to focus when the modal opens.

keepMounted.description: Keeps the modal DOM mounted when closed.

maxWidth.description: Maximum width of the modal dialog.

maxHeight.description: Maximum height of the modal dialog.

minWidth.description: Minimum width of the modal dialog.

minHeight.description: Minimum height of the modal dialog.

fullScreen.description: Expands the modal to fill the viewport.

centered.description: Vertically centers the modal in the viewport.

reduceMotion.description: Controls motion preferences. 'auto' respects the user's OS setting.

nestingLevel.description: Current nesting depth for stacked modals. Managed automatically.

maxNestingLevel.description: Maximum allowed nesting depth for stacked modals.

zIndex.description: CSS z-index for the modal layer.

classes.description: CSS class overrides for modal sub-elements.

unstyled.description: Removes all default styling, rendering a plain dialog.

className.description: Additional CSS class for the dialog content panel.

contentStyle.description: Inline styles for the dialog content panel.

aria-label.description: Accessible label for the modal dialog.

aria-labelledby.description: ID of the element that labels the modal dialog.

aria-describedby.description: ID of the element that describes the modal dialog.
